name: Agent
about: The art director's own sculpt of the agent piece (agent-piece.obj, from her script spy3d.py), turned into the game's model file by Tools/obj_to_model.py. One unit is the figure, from the base's top to the hat's crown. A faceless figure in a raincoat and hat with a case and a lantern, on a brass-rimmed base; the lantern's panes are a file of their own.
